details: Cryptocurrency investor Christopher Harborne has donated £36 million to the UK's Reform Party, matching a similar donation from fellow crypto billionaire Ben Delo. This brings the party's total funding from crypto billionaires to £72 million in less than 48 hours. Reform UK has publicly stated its intention to boost crypto adoption if it comes to power, including proposals to cut capital gains tax for digital assets and create a Bitcoin reserve fund at the Bank of England.
title: UK's Reform Party Receives Record £36M Donation from Crypto Billionaire

details: Maritime authorities have reported a new attack on a vessel in the Strait of Hormuz, a critical global oil transit chokepoint. This comes as Saudi Arabia has temporarily shut down its East-West oil pipeline as a precautionary measure, following drone attacks originating from Iraq. The East-West pipeline is vital for Saudi Arabia as it allows oil exports to bypass the Strait of Hormuz, which has been largely closed due to the ongoing conflict between the US and Iran. These escalating tensions have caused Brent crude prices to surge past $100 a barrel, fueling concerns over global energy supplies.
title: Middle East Tensions Escalate with Strait of Hormuz Attack and Saudi Oil Pipeline Shutdown
